commander_required_message: This feature requires Vox Commander to be installed and configured
camera_permission_required: Camera permission is required to scan.
general_menu_desc: OCR language zone, auto-capture timing, photo-to-AI and stitching strictness
logs_settings_menu_desc: Debug logging and the captured log, to read, copy or share
sensitivity_high: High (catches more, may trigger on clutter)
send_photo_to_ai_desc: Attach the scanned photo alongside the recognized text when a multimodal AI engine is configured — off by default since this costs extra tokens on top of the free local OCR text
debug_logging_desc: Write debug info to logcat — leave off unless you're troubleshooting an issue
splash_engine_error: Engine components not found or no internet. Please check your connection and try again.
stitch_discontinuity_warning: This shot doesn't look like it continues from the last one
stitch_continuity_strictness_desc: How much text overlap is required between consecutive stitch shots before they're accepted without a retake prompt
auto_capture_delay_desc: Once a document is framed, capture either waits for a manual tap or fires on its own after the chosen delay
liveview_menu_desc: Live text links: categories, precision, target apps
liveview_show_frame_desc: The detector runs either way; this only draws or hides its rectangle.
liveview_kind_phone_desc: Exact needs a prefix, a label or your country’s format; fuzzy also accepts grouped digits.
liveview_kind_email_desc: Fuzzy forgives a comma the scan put where a dot belongs.
liveview_kind_url_desc: Exact needs http or www; fuzzy also claims bare domains like example.com.
liveview_kind_address_desc: Exact needs a street word; fuzzy also accepts a numbered place without one.
liveview_kind_generic_desc: Plain text offers search and copy; the app picked here does the searching.
liveview_custom_desc: A name, your pattern, and the app that receives what it matches. Your categories outrank the built-in ones.
liveview_onb_1: 1. Hold the camera steady over a card, a flyer, a label.
liveview_onb_2: 2. Recognized text gets small chips anchored to it — a phone number offers a call, a message, a chat.
liveview_onb_3: 3. Tap a chip to act. Categories, precision and target apps are yours to change in Settings.
liveview_onb_permission: LiveView needs the camera — everything is read on this phone and nothing leaves it.
liveview_pace_desc: How eagerly the rectangle follows the scene — calmer is steadier, faster reacts sooner.
liveview_rescan_desc: How readily finished chips are let go of for a fresh read. Persistent keeps them for as long as the document stays in frame.
liveview_style_desc: How a finished reading is shown: chips over the live text, boxes filled with the recognized text, or a frozen frame with the fields as a table.
